messages:
Eileen Park: Quick capture from the "routing policies & launch bar" breakout. Goal: agree a minimal public promise and an internal checklist for multi-region + tenant isolation launches. Keep it terse.
Jordan Miles: Public promise should be two lines: latency SLA tiers + residency options. Internally we need explicit launch gates and an owner for each.
Marco Liu: Tech gates: migration tooling present, canary automation, cache warm strategy, and policy DSL examples. If any of these is missing -> block.
Tess O'Neill: Product gates: pricing stub, sales one-pager, and customer opt-in workflow. Also lead time estimate for hard isolation (how long to provision).
Vikram Rao: Ops: define evacuation semantics per policy template. For soft residency -> fallback allowed; for hard -> fail with clear error and escalation path. Also require headroom metric >= 10% before full cutover.
Eileen Park: Draft minimal acceptance checklist (for RFC):
- Canary: 10% for >=48h or template-specified window
- Metrics: p50/p95 latency, error rate delta, token cost delta, cache hit-rate
- Quality: eval harness runs; block if regression >2% absolute on core prompts
- Capacity: regional headroom >=10% prior to cutover; plan for warm-up
- Compliance: audit log + who/why + KMS flag check for hard isolation
- Runbook: automated rollback + notification hooks
Jordan Miles: Add economic gate: cost delta per 1M tokens compared to hosted baseline must be documented and accepted by customer for hard isolation.
Marco Liu: Migration CLI stub:
```
rw migrate start --tenant T42 --policy residency-hard --canary 10 --warm-kv true
rw migrate status --id 20260411-001
```
Tess O'Neill: Sales one-liner: "Dedicated residency options with configurable isolation and SLA; contact sales for pricing." Keep it non-technical.
Vikram Rao: Evacuation behaviors matrix (ops):
- soft residency: overflow -> shared pool, up to 30s queue
- hard residency: overflow -> reject (429) + immediate pager
- latency-first: spill to nearest low-latency pool, degrade throughput if needed
audit-bot: RFC draft created: /rfc/routing-launch-bar-draft (owner: Eileen).
Eileen Park: Owners: Jordan -> pricing/sales wording, Marco -> migration tooling, Tess -> sales materials & lead time, Vikram -> evacuation playbooks, me -> acceptance checklist + RFC. Will reconvene after RFC comments.
Jordan Miles: Finance check: propose baseline uplift estimates: soft +12%, hard +30% (shepherd with finance).
Tess O'Neill: I'll add the lead time table: soft 2-5 days, hard 10-21 days (provisional).
Eileen Park: Thanks all. I'll post the RFC link in main channel once it's updated.
